{{ e.employee_code }} {{ e.employee_name }} {{ e.reporting_manager_name or e.reporting_manager_code }} {{ e.submitted_on }}

description: Functional manager review reminder - one email per functional manager listing every employee waiting on their rating.
name: J-Reflect Functional Manager Review
subject: J-Reflect: {{ employee_count }} evaluation(s) awaiting your functional manager rating
variables:
receiver_name, receiver_email - the manager receiving the email
review_stage - Functional Manager Review / Skip Level Manager Review
employee_count - number of employees in this email
digitrack_url - link to JH DigiTrack
review_url - direct link to the J-Reflect review page
employees - list; each has employee_code, employee_name, year, reporting_manager_code, reporting_manager_name, submitted_by, submitted_on

body:
Dear {{ md_name }},

Rental Renewal {{ renewal_name }} for property {{ property_name }} has been approved by CFO.

Property Details

Renewal{{ renewal_name }}
Property{{ property_name }}
Type{{ business_used }} {{ property_type }}
Division{{ division }}
Location{{ location }}
Landlord{{ landlord }}
Renewal Period{{ renewal_from }} - {{ renewal_to }}
Current Rent{{ current_rent }}
Proposed Rent{{ proposed_rent }}
Rent Change{{ rent_change }} ({{ rent_change_percent }}%)

Rent change is ≤ 5%, so MD approval is not required. This is for your information.

You can view the renewal in JH DigiTrack.

This is an automated message. This email inbox is not actively monitored.
description: FYI to the MD when the CFO approves a rental renewal with rent change ≤ 5% (MD approval not required).
name: Property MD FYI
subject: Rental Renewal Approved (No MD Approval Required)
variables:
md_name - MD's full name (falls back to "Sir")
renewal_name, renewal_label - renewal ID, and the "Retail Shop rent renewal 01.01.2026-31.12.2026" label
property_name, business_used, property_type, division, location, landlord
renewal_from, renewal_to - dd.mm.yyyy
current_rent, proposed_rent, rent_change - formatted amounts
rent_change_percent - e.g. 4.50
actor_name - who acted (the CFO), action_label - approved / sent back / ...
digitrack_url - link to JH DigiTrack

body:
Dear {{ md_name }},

Rental Renewal {{ renewal_name }} for property {{ property_name }} has been {{ action_label }} by {{ actor_name }} and is now awaiting your approval. The rent change is {{ rent_change_percent }}%, which is above 5%.

Renewal Details

Renewal{{ renewal_name }}
Property{{ property_name }}
Type{{ business_used }} {{ property_type }}
Renewal Period{{ renewal_from }} - {{ renewal_to }}
Current Rent{{ current_rent }}
Proposed Rent{{ proposed_rent }}
Rent Change{{ rent_change }} ({{ rent_change_percent }}%)

Please log in to JH DigiTrack to take action.

This is an automated message. This email inbox is not actively monitored.
description: Sent to the MD when a rental renewal reaches Pending MD (rent change > 5%) and needs MD approval.
name: Property MD Approval Request
subject: {{ renewal_label }}
variables:
md_name - MD's full name (falls back to "Sir")
renewal_name, renewal_label - renewal ID, and the "Retail Shop rent renewal 01.01.2026-31.12.2026" label
property_name, business_used, property_type, division, location, landlord
renewal_from, renewal_to - dd.mm.yyyy
current_rent, proposed_rent, rent_change - formatted amounts
rent_change_percent - e.g. 4.50
actor_name - who acted (the CFO), action_label - approved / sent back / ...
digitrack_url - link to JH DigiTrack
